mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Trivlu was born from a simple frustration: planning group trips shouldn't be harder than the trip itself. We believe that bringing people together for shared adventures should be seamless, exciting, and stress-free.
mission.p2: Our AI-powered platform takes the chaos out of coordinating multi-traveler experiences. From selecting destinations to building custom itineraries, Trivlu handles the logistics so you can focus on making memories.

adventure.title: Adventure First
adventure.body: We curate destinations and activities that create unforgettable experiences for groups of all sizes.

stress.title: Zero Stress
stress.body: Our smart trip builder handles the complexity of group coordination so you don't have to.

together.title: Better Together
together.body: Travel is best when shared. We design every feature to bring groups closer together.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: It started with a weekend trip that almost didn't happen. Too many group chats, conflicting preferences, and last-minute cancellations nearly derailed what should have been a simple getaway.
story.p2: That experience sparked an idea: what if there was a platform that made planning group adventures as fun as the adventures themselves? Trivlu is the answer — the first AI-powered trip maker built specifically for multi-traveler experiences.

vote.q1: Is Prague still a good choice in 2026? I read that bachelor parties were banned.
vote.q1a1: Prague banned no bachelor parties. The city banned commercial pub crawls in November 2024. The ban covers the historic centre between 22:00 and 06:00. The fine reaches 100,000 CZK. The fine applies to the tour company, not to your group. Your friends may walk from one pub to another at any hour.
vote.q1a2: The city centre also contains no-drinking zones. An open can in your hand costs up to 10,000 CZK. Our evenings start earlier. Our evenings happen inside venues, not on the street. These rules affect no part of your weekend.
vote.q2: Does everyone need to download an app or create an account?
vote.q2a: No. You share one link. Your friends open the link in a browser. No app, no account, no password. You only leave your details before booking.
vote.q3a: One person pays a 30 percent deposit by card. The deposit reserves every activity. The group pays the remaining balance on arrival. Free cancellation protects your group if the group size changes.
vote.q4: We are not interested in strip clubs. Is there anything else?
vote.q4a: Trivlu offers 72 activities. Only one category out of eight contains adult entertainment. Choose rafting, shooting, karting or axe throwing. Choose a beer spa, a brewery tour or a river cruise. Choose bubble football or tank driving. Many groups ignore the adult category completely.
vote.q5: Do you book flights and hotels too?
vote.q5a: No. Trivlu adds no fee to flights or hotels. You find better prices yourself. Trivlu shows realistic price ranges for both. Trivlu books the activities, plans the timing, and solves problems in the city.
vote.q6a: Tell us. We change the booking. Free cancellation covers every activity. Watch the minimum group price. Some activities charge a minimum price for the whole group. Trivlu shows the minimum price on the activity card.
vote.q7: What is the smallest group you accept?
vote.q7a: A group of four works for most activities. Smaller groups pay more per person for activities with a minimum group price. Trivlu shows the exact price before you book.
vote.q8: How fast do you really reply?
vote.q8a: We reply within ten minutes, seven days a week. Call {phone}. Or send a message to the same number on WhatsApp.

prague.q1: When is the best time to go?
prague.q1a: Choose May, June or September. The weather suits the Vltava river and the outdoor activities. The city stays calm. July and August bring heat and crowds. Winter is cheap and the bars are excellent. Winter closes rafting and outdoor shooting.
prague.q2: How far ahead should we book?
prague.q2a: Book six to eight weeks ahead. Flights cost about 44 percent less than a last-minute booking. The popular Saturday slots stay open. Four weeks still works. Two weeks works with a smaller choice.
prague.q3: Do you organise the accommodation and transfers?
prague.q3a: Trivlu offers airport transfers as an activity. Trivlu sells no hotels. You find a better price yourself. Trivlu adds no fee. We name the districts that keep every venue walkable.
prague.q4: Is Prague safe for a large group?
prague.q4a: Yes. Watch for pickpockets around Charles Bridge and Old Town Square. Never change money on the street. Agree the taxi price before the ride. Our guides manage the venue arrangements. We book only partner venues.
prague.q5: We are not interested in strip clubs. Is there anything else?

rules.title: “Did Prague ban bachelor parties?”
rules.lede: No. One rule changed in 2024. Most websites explain the rule badly. Read the facts below.
rules.mythH: “Bachelor parties are banned and you get fined.”
rules.mythP: Headlines about a pub crawl ban created this belief. No law made group travel to Prague illegal.
rules.factH: Commercial pub crawls cannot run at night
rules.factP1: The city banned commercial pub crawls in November 2024. The ban covers the historic centre between 22:00 and 06:00. The fine reaches 100,000 CZK. The fine applies to the company, not to your group.
rules.factP2: Your friends may walk from one pub to another at any hour.
rules.l1t: is banned in parts of the city centre. An open can in your hand costs up to 10,000 CZK. Bar terraces and beer gardens remain legal.
rules.l2t: left Prague in January 2026. Bikes and public transport still operate. The centre stays walkable.
rules.l3t: is permitted for any driver, including a cyclist. Not half a beer. None.
rules.l4t: work in party bars. Better clubs and traditional beer halls refuse a group in matching outfits.
rules.noteT: Our evenings start earlier. Our evenings happen inside partner venues, not on the street. We worked in Prague through the rule change. No Trivlu group ever received a fine.
